groups.defect: The lazy `translate` loads only `config.locale`, and only ApplicationController loads the fallback chain. So in jobs, mailers, rake tasks and the console, fallback lookups miss and the 'translation missing' result gets cached. Separately, the LRU cache key leaves out SiteSetting.default_locale, so cached fallback text goes stale after the default locale changes.
groups.rationale: Five suggestions report the same defect: fallback locales are not loaded outside controllers. s_6a01472a also reports the stale cache key after a default_locale change, which is the only thing s_e15dc8b6 reports, so the overlap pulls s_e15dc8b6 into the group.
